description: This Java class 'VariableRegistry' manages a registry of variable definitions, supports variable substitution within strings, and generates constant definition code for C and Java. It maintains mappings from variable names to their string or integer values, supports dynamic registration, and produces code snippets for configuration purposes.

classes.name: VariableRegistry
classes.description: A singleton class extending TreeMap that handles variable registration, substitution, and code generation for configuration variables in Java and C.

methods.name: applyVariables
methods.description: Replaces variable references like @@var@@ in a string with their actual values, throwing an exception if a variable is missing.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a variable with a string value, updating internal maps and generating code snippets.

methods.name: tryToRegisterAsInteger
methods.description: Attempts to parse and register a variable as an integer; if unsuccessful, may treat it as a string constant.

methods.name: isQuoted
methods.description: Determines if a string value is enclosed in double quotes.

methods.name: writeNumericsToFile
methods.description: Writes all registered numeric constants and definitions to a specified header file.

methods.name: getJavaConstants
methods.description: Returns all Java constants (numeric and string) as concatenated string.
